plugin.name: place
plugin._long: A plugin to position newly opened windows.

option.name: mode
option._long: Specifies how to position newly opened windows.

desc._tooltip: Places the window where it overlaps other windows least, preferring to sit under windows that are already behind. After Compiz's placeSmart. Unmovable windows are left alone; unparented Xwayland dialogs and splash screens are centered; utility windows are left alone. Native Wayland dialogs cannot be detected (xdg-shell has no window type) and are still smart-placed.
